component.name: PoniaFE
component.summary: Customizable graphical frontend for launching emulators

description.p: PoniaFE is a Qt 6 port of Pegasus Frontend by Mátyás Mustoha. It is a graphical frontend for browsing your game library (especially retro games) and launching them from one place, focusing on customizability, embedded devices and high performance.
Themes and metadata files made for Pegasus keep working in PoniaFE.

component.developer_name: PoniaFE contributors (based on Pegasus Frontend by Mátyás Mustoha)
